Nora Li: Hi all! Nora here — joining Product Design today. Remote-first. Quick Qs: I don't have access to the Redwood Figma org yet, and I wanted to confirm the home office stipend process. Also who should I book a 1:1 with for design onboarding? :wave:
Priya (Design): welcome Nora!! :tada: Excited to have you. I'll add you to the weekly design sync. For onboarding 1:1s, please book with Carlos — he's mentoring new designers this quarter.
Carlos M.: hey Nora, welcome! I'll send a calendar for a 30m intro and a walkthrough of our component library. Also fyi we do design pairing on Tuesdays.
Nora Li: thanks Carlos. Also, can someone ping the Figma admin? I tried the invite link and it says "not found".
Jamie (Design Ops): hey Nora — welcome. Figma invites are sent from figma@redwood.design. I just re-sent the invite to your work email (nora.li@redwood.ai). Check spam and log in at https://www.figma.com/files/team/Redwood. If you still get an error, paste the exact message here.
Nora Li: got it, I see the invite now and I'm in. Pulled the design assets library — thanks! :raised_hands:
Nora Li: about the stipend — what's the form? I can submit receipts once my desk arrives.
ITHelpBot: Desk/home office stipend request: https://redwood.internal/forms/home-office. Stipend policy: up to $500 for new hires within first 90 days. Attach receipts and shipping/tracking if ordering furniture.
Jamie (Design Ops): For reimbursement, fill that form and tag me. We also have a company card option for purchases over $200 — DM if you'd rather charge it directly.
Priya (Design): adding you to #design and #design-crit. Also @here welcome Nora! Quick two truths & a lie: Nora bakes sourdough, climbed El Capitan last year, used to DJ in college — which one's a lie? :smile:
Nora Li: haha — I bake sourdough and used to DJ. The climb is the lie (not brave enough yet). :bread: :headphones:
Carlos M.: love it. FYI the component tokens live in Figma under /Design System/Tokens. We'll review them in the walkthrough.
OnboardBot: New hire checklist: Nora Li added to groups 'product-design', 'design-sync'. Onboarding tasks: 3/6 complete. https://redwood.internal/onboard/1745001111
Nora Li: everyone super helpful — I confirmed Figma, submitted the stipend form, and accepted Carlos' invite. Thanks so much! :heart:
